articles.title: PHP Foundation admits ‘structural failure’ delayed critical security fix
articles.snippet: Government websites and online services were disrupted after concerns about a PHP bug that could allow attackers to take control of vulnerable servers.

articles.title: Nvidia Unveils Its Full-Stack Blueprint to Contain and Monitor AI Agents
articles.snippet: Nvidia's OpenShell Reference Architecture pairs a software sandbox on Vera CPUs with Sentry monitoring on BlueField-4 chips, aiming to let companies run autonomous agents while enforcing limits agents cannot reach.

articles.title: PHP Panic: Two Critical Bugs Put 70% of the Internet at Risk, and Everyone Is Freaking Out
articles.snippet: Two critical bugs in PHP, the language running most of the web, let strangers take over servers without a password. The patch is out, attacks started early, and governments pulled the plug.

articles.title: Wallet Linked to Drift Exploit Sends $61 Million in Ethereum to Tornado Cash
articles.snippet: The North Korea-linked attacker behind April's $295 million Drift heist pushed 25,700 ETH through the mixer in two hours, and still controls roughly $198 million more.
